theme_and_archetype.theme: Light mode default, Dark mode toggle

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Dense but readable. p-4 or p-6 for cards. Container px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8.
layout_and_spacing.sidebar: Smart collapsible. w-16 collapsed, w-64 expanded. z-40. Transition width 300ms ease. Icon-only until hovered or pinned.
layout_and_spacing.header: h-16 fixed top-0 right-0 z-30 flex items-center justify-between px-6. Background crystal glass (bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200).
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: Bento-style Control Room grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6.

component_rules.cards: Flat background, 1px border border-slate-200, shadow-sm. Use rounded-md or rounded-lg. No extreme border-radius.
component_rules.tables_general: Dense rows. text-sm. Hover state on rows. Colored badges for status.

erp_spreadsheet.behavior: Horizontal scrolling with overflow-x-auto. Sticky header (sticky top-0 bg-white z-10) and sticky first column (sticky left-0 bg-white shadow-[2px_0_5px_-2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)] z-20).
erp_spreadsheet.mutual_exclusion: Typing in VALOR DE VENDA clears MARGEM % and highlights background yellow. Vice-versa.
erp_spreadsheet.cell_styling: Yellow inputs use bg-yellow-50, green profit uses bg-emerald-50, blue value uses bg-blue-50. Dark mode variants provided in color scale.

component_rules.hero_alerts: Large hero cards. p-6, border-l-4 border-red-500. Massive text-5xl time display with clock icon.
component_rules.timeline_stepper: Vertical layout. 10 steps. Active step uses primary color, completed uses green, future uses gray. Add file icon on each step.
component_rules.inputs: Shadcn components, h-9 or h-10. focus-visible:ring-primary focus-visible:ring-2.
component_rules.offcanvas_sidebar: Advanced filter sidebar. fixed inset-y-0 right-0 w-80 bg-white shadow-xl z-50 transform transition-transform.

motion_and_microinteractions.sidebar: Width transition on hover. Menu labels fade in.
motion_and_microinteractions.undo_toast: 7s undo via Sonner with progress indicator.
motion_and_microinteractions.chart: Recharts donut chart stroke animation on mount.
motion_and_microinteractions.table_inputs: Smooth background color transition when mutual exclusion triggers.

icons_and_assets.usage: Size 18px for general UI, 24px for sidebar, 48px for hero alerts. Stroke width 2.

data_testid_conventions.rules: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
data_testid_conventions.format: kebab-case, role-based. e.g., data-testid='sidebar-toggle', data-testid='new-bid-button', data-testid='erp-table-input-margin'

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard HTML/Tailwind for the 21-column ERP table to ensure performance. Use 'sticky' classes for headers and the first column.
Implement mutual exclusion logic in the ERP table using controlled React state or ref-based value clearing on input change.
Sidebar must use state 'isExpanded' and 'isPinned'. If 'isPinned' is false, 'isExpanded' becomes true only on hover.
Use Recharts for the donut chart in Tela 4.
Use Sonner for the 7s undo toast when deleting a bid.
Files MUST be written in .jsx or .js. Do NOT use .tsx.
